text:
lia: FYI found a debug tar uploaded to gs://ci-debug-uploads/2026-04-05/host-77.tar.gz that contains a VAULT_TOKEN and an SA JSON. Marking incident P0.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 created and oncall paged.

omar: Can you paste a masked grep so we can scope quickly?

lia: Masked snippet: 
```
VAULT_TOKEN=***redacted-token***
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/creds.json
{"type":"service_account", "project_id":"redwood-ci", "private_key_id":"***", "private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n***\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

lia: Bucket lifecycle is 14d and ACL allowed internal-collab and two external contractors.

sophia: Playbook I'm running: 1) Revoke Vault accessor + revoke leases. 2) Delete SA key and issue new key with minimal roles. 3) Narrow IAM on that SA to the ci-debug bucket only. 4) Shorten bucket TTL to 24h and enable object access logs. 5) Ramp up Vault audit logging for 7d.

ops-oncall: Executing now. Commands I'll run: 
```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***"
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEYID --iam-account=ci-debug@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=ci-debug@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-ci
```

ops-oncall: Completed revoke and key delete, created new key and placed it in Vault at secret/ci/debug/new-key with 1h lease.

omar: Running quick audit: Vault shows token-lookup and one KV read under secret/data/ci/testflags (non-prod). GCP shows SA used to PUT object to the bucket at 2026-04-05T09:04Z. No signs of prod secret reads.

sophia: I'll rewrap any artifacts encrypted by legacy-KMS and schedule transit rekey if necessary. Also adding a deny rule so ci-debug SA can't access prod buckets.

lia: I've opened a short-lived RBAC PR to remove broad storage roles from ci-debug SA and scope to the one bucket.

omar: Setting alert to notify security if any denied->allowed IAM changes occur for that SA.

lia: Scheduling a 30min post-incident review tomorrow 10:00 PT to discuss why debug artifacts include credentials and to propose agent hardening (env scrubbing).

ops-oncall: Updating INC-2026-211 with actions and marking initial containment complete.
